judgements.name: opencode-devcontainers
reasons: Criterion 3 warning: repository is archived (no active maintainer), so it does not meet the maintained-source requirement.
Criterion 5 info: no egress is declared, so network access cannot be verified.
judgements.user_note: This plugin is archived and its network egress is undeclared, so it is not eligible for continued listing.

judgements.name: opencode-dynamic-context-pruning
reasons: Criterion 1 warning: license is AGPL-3.0-or-later (OSI-approved copyleft), so copyleft terms should be clearly disclosed to users.
Criterion 7 info: version is pinned to 3.2.0 with integrity match, while npm latest is 3.2.1.
Criterion 5 info: no egress is declared, so network behavior cannot be verified yet.
judgements.user_note: This plugin remains listed, but users should be informed it is AGPL-licensed copyleft software.

judgements.name: opencode-conductor
reasons: Criterion 6 warning: runs a postinstall script on install (`node scripts/postinstall.cjs`), so script review is required before verification.
Criterion 5 info: no egress is declared, so network behavior cannot be verified yet.
judgements.user_note: This plugin can remain community-listed, but verify the postinstall script and publish explicit egress declarations before considering verified status.

judgements.name: opencode-sentry-monitor
reasons: Criterion 2 warning: no public source repository found, so public/maintained-source requirement is not satisfied.
Criterion 5 info: no egress declared, which is required before network behavior can be verified.
judgements.user_note: This plugin can remain listed with a warning until the maintainer publishes source and declares egress for verification.

judgements.name: opencode-goal-plugin
reasons: Criterion 3 warning: npm package is deprecated and superseded by 0.11.4 (final release).
Criterion 7 info: version is pinned to 0.10.0 while latest is 0.11.4.
Criterion 5 info: no egress is declared, so network behavior cannot be verified yet.
judgements.user_note: This plugin can remain listed for now, but users should upgrade the pin to 0.11.4 or use the built-in /goal in OpenCode 2.2.1+.
